headline: A 2000 executive order from President Clinton directed federal action to help improve schools that were performing poorly.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to take steps aimed at improving low-performing public schools. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, the agencies involved, and any funding or deadlines are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: Their schools may be the focus of federal improvement efforts under this order.
They may work with federal agencies on efforts to improve schools that are struggling.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 3, 2000; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
